deu: The device is an x-ray diffractometer for the analysis of semiconductor wafers at different positions. It must allow the standard XRD measurements (2theta-omega, rocking curves, reciprocal space maps, x-ray reflectivity) with sufficiently high throughput to enable the assessment of full wafers and crystals as well as of arbitrarily shaped pieces of wafers and crystals. The materials to be investigated include semiconductor samples partly with epitaxial layers (e.g. GaN, GaN on Si, GaN on sapphire, GaN on GaN, AlN, AlN on AlN, SiGe stacks, SiC, SiC on SiC) and engineered substrates, where a thin layer of one material is bonded on a carrier wafer.
